description: This file defines the interface for remote connections within the WPEFramework RPC namespace, including the IRemoteConnection interface, its nested INotification interface, and iterator type definitions for strings and uint32_t. It includes method declarations for managing remote connections and acquiring interfaces.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection
classes.description: Interface representing a remote connection, providing methods for identification, termination, launching, and interface acquisition.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for remote connection notifications, with callbacks for activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: IStringIterator
classes.description: Type alias for an iterator over strings within the RPC namespace.

classes.name: IValueIterator
classes.description: Type alias for an iterator over uint32_t values within the RPC namespace.

methods.name: Aquire
methods.description: Template method to acquire a specific interface type from the remote connection, casting the void pointer returned by the base Aquire method.
